🐛 Describe the bug
When using PyTorch 2.7.1 to compile np.round, I found that although the compilation process works, the caching mechanism does not apply. Specifically, in the load function of AOTAutogradCache located in torch/_functorch/_aot_autograd/autograd_cache.py, two errors occur when generating dump information via the autograd_cache_key function. There are two types of errors:

The check_cacheable check within autograd_cache_key fails.



If I temporarily comment out the check_cacheable check, a subsequent import error occurs.


I noticed that the check_cacheable function called by AOTAutogradCache explicitly states that it currently only supports torch.* functions. However, I would like to know how to make AOTAutogradCache support NumPy operations (e.g., np.round). Are there any recommended approaches to extend this caching mechanism to include NumPy operations?

import torch
import numpy as np
def round(input):
    return np.round(input)

input = np.random.randint(0, 256, (100, 100, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
round_compile = torch.compile(round)
with torch.device("cuda"):

🐛 Describe the bug
We cut a release branch for the 2.8.0 release.
Our plan from this point from this point is roughly:

Phase 1 (until 7/7/25): work on finalizing the release branch
Phase 2 (after 7/7/25): perform extended integration/stability/performance testing based on Release Candidate builds.

This issue is for tracking cherry-picks to the release branch.
Cherry-Pick Criteria
Phase 1 (until 7/7/25):
Only low-risk changes may be cherry-picked from main:

Fixes to regressions against the most recent minor release (e.g. 2.7.x for this release; see module: regression issue list)
Critical fixes for: silent correctness, backwards compatibility, crashes, deadlocks, (large) memory leaks
Critical fixes to new features introduced in the most recent minor release (e.g. 2.7.x for this release)
Test/CI fixes
Documentation improvements
Compilation fixes or ifdefs required for different versions of the compilers or third-party libraries
Release branch specific changes (e.g. change version identifiers)

Any other change requires special dispensation from the release managers (currently @atalman, @malfet, @Camyll ). If this applies to your change please write "Special Dispensation" in the "Criteria Category:" template below and explain.
Phase 2 (after 7/7/25):
Note that changes here require us to rebuild a Release Candidate and restart extended testing (likely delaying the release). Therefore, the only accepted changes are Release-blocking critical fixes for: silent correctness, backwards compatibility, crashes, deadlocks, (large) memory leaks
Changes will likely require a discussion with the larger release team over VC or Slack.
Cherry-Pick Process


Ensure your PR has landed in master. This does not apply for release-branch specific changes (see Phase 1 criteria).


Create (but do not land) a PR against the release branch.

You can also use the @pytorchbot cherry-pick command to cherry-pick your PR. To do this, just add a comment in your merged PR. For example:
@pytorchbot cherry-pick --onto release/2.8 -c docs

For more information, see pytorchbot cherry-pick docs.

Link to landed trunk PR (if applicable):

*

Someone from the release team will reply with approved / denied or ask for more information.
If approved, someone from the release team will merge your PR once the tests pass. Do not land the release branch PR yourself.
